title:
mkdir -p /root/output && cat > /tmp/run_analysis.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pymannkendall as mk
from factor_analyzer import FactorAnalyzer
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

DATA_DIR = Path('/root/data')
OUTPUT_DIR = Path('/root/output')

water = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / 'water_temperature.csv')
climate = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / 'climate.csv')
land_cover = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / 'land_cover.csv')
hydrology = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / 'hydrology.csv')

# Align every predictor to the annual water-temperature observations.
data = water.merge(climate, on='Year', validate='one_to_one')
data = data.merge(land_cover, on='Year', validate='one_to_one')
data = data.merge(hydrology, on='Year', validate='one_to_one').sort_values('Year')

# Sen's slope with Mann-Kendall p-value, appropriate for environmental time series.
trend = mk.original_test(data['WaterTemperature'].to_numpy())
pd.DataFrame([{'slope': trend.slope, 'p-value': trend.p}]).to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / 'trend_result.csv', index=False
)

categories = {
    'Heat': ['AirTempLake', 'Shortwave', 'Longwave'],
    'Flow': ['Precip', 'Inflow', 'Outflow'],
    'Wind': ['WindSpeedLake'],
    'Human': ['DevelopedArea', 'AgricultureArea'],
}
predictors = [variable for variables in categories.values() for variable in variables]
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(data[predictors])
y = data['WaterTemperature'].to_numpy()

# One global four-factor varimax model, then map factors to distinct physical categories
# using the strongest total absolute standardized loading assignment.
factor_model = FactorAnalyzer(n_factors=4, rotation='varimax', method='minres')
factor_scores = factor_model.fit_transform(X)
loadings = pd.DataFrame(factor_model.loadings_, index=predictors)
category_loading = np.array([
    loadings.loc[variables].abs().sum(axis=0).to_numpy()
    for variables in categories.values()
])
row_indices, factor_indices = linear_sum_assignment(-category_loading)
category_factor = {
    list(categories)[row_index]: factor_index
    for row_index, factor_index in zip(row_indices, factor_indices)
}

def r_squared(features, response):
    model = LinearRegression().fit(features, response)
    return model.score(features, response)

full_r2 = r_squared(factor_scores, y)
contributions = {}
for category, factor_index in category_factor.items():
    remaining_factor_indices = [index for index in range(4) if index != factor_index]
    contributions[category] = max(0.0, full_r2 - r_squared(factor_scores[:, remaining_factor_indices], y)) * 100

dominant_category = max(contributions, key=contributions.get)
pd.DataFrame([{
    'variable': dominant_category,
    'contribution': contributions[dominant_category],
}]).to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / 'dominant_factor.csv', index=False)

print('Trend:', trend.slope, trend.p)
print('Factor-category mapping:', category_factor)
print('Contributions:', contributions)
print('Full R2:', full_r2)
print('Loadings:')
print(loadings)
PY
